name: harness-framework
description: Multi-agent workflow orchestration engine: Consul KV-based DAG scheduling, zombie task recovery, inter-agent message bus, and WebAPI dashboard. Zero external dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent workflow engine with DAG scheduling and Consul KV state management
interface.longDescription: Harness Framework is the core orchestration engine for multi-agent development. It provides DAG-based task dependency scheduling, zombie task recovery via watchdog, inter-agent messaging, and a WebAPI dashboard for monitoring and control. Zero external Python dependencies — stdlib only.
defaultPrompt: Start the Harness framework and initialize a workflow.
Set up a multi-agent development pipeline for this project.
Monitor the current workflow status across all agents.
